subject: C05
required_fixes: RF01 [P2] Preserve unknown mutation outcomes in the rendered knowledge-check experience. The newly consumed .inputs/academy/src/features/units/components/knowledge-check-runner.tsx:288 replaces every submission error with 'Could not submit this check. Your answers are still here; try again.' Its start-error branch at :212 also discards outcome guidance. desktop-link.ts correctly reports that Academy may have applied the mutation, but the actual page hides that distinction. An independent in-memory React DOM probe reproduced the misleading submission alert for an error carrying outcome=unknown and the native readback guidance. Acceptance: composed learner-page tests inject lost replies and HTTP 5xx for start/submit, show a possibly-applied explanation and check-current-state guidance, preserve answers, distinguish definite refusals, and send no automatic repeat. Fix this in the Academy-owned presentation/host contract without duplicating the learner UI.

RF02 [P2] Restore visible mutation-failure feedback for the imported learner pages. apps/desktop/src/features/academy/learner-provider.tsx:28 creates a QueryClient without Academy's mutation-error reporting, and its composition at :79 mounts no notification presenter. The shared UnitPage at .inputs/academy/src/features/units/pages/unit-page.tsx:187 handles completion success only and never renders complete.error; inline checks and enrollment removal also depend on missing shared feedback. A guest can read a lesson, press 'Complete & continue', receive the native UNAUTHORIZED refusal, and see no error or navigation. An independent React DOM probe confirmed one completion invocation, zero navigation, zero alerts and no sign-in guidance. Acceptance: guest completion explicitly requests sign-in or offers clearly labelled guest navigation; signed-in denial/network failures remain visible and accessible, retain the page/input, and preserve unknown-outcome semantics. Exercise these flows through the composed desktop learner provider, keeping notifications inside Academy.

RF03 [P1] Scope completion effects to the learner generation. .inputs/academy/src/features/units/components/completion-moments.tsx:87 and :143 retain watched course and pending moments in module globals; :181/:241 render the queue without checking its account owner. LearnerProvider's keyed remount and QueryClient.clear at apps/desktop/src/features/academy/learner-provider.tsx:75/:98 do not clear or isolate these stores. An independent React DOM probe queued a module completion for account A, remounted the component as a guest, and still rendered 'Module secure: ACCOUNT A PRIVATE MODULE'; the old watched course also survived. A subsequent account can inherit the old celebration/progress metadata and watch registration. Acceptance: Academy-owned effect state is isolated or retired on account-generation changes and reset, with stale callbacks unable to repopulate it; tests cover a queued module/course celebration across sign-out, account B, reset, and leaving/re-entering Academy. No prior-account completion or watch request may appear in the new generation.

RF04 [P2] Extend consumed-dependency verification to the new Academy packages. apps/desktop/package.json:13 adds file-installed @ai-security-academy/learner and @ai-security-academy/shared, but crates/xtask/src/fingerprint.rs:301-339 and verify_consumed_shared at :372 hash/compare only the installed presentation package. node_modules is excluded from the source and scratch-tree hashes. Editing either newly consumed installed copy therefore escapes the frozen source/dependency checks even though Vite compiles it. I independently compared the current installed learner/shared copies with the pinned input and found them equal; the defect is missing invalidation coverage, not an observed mismatch. Acceptance: fingerprint and verify every consumed Academy file-package copy against its pinned input, including modes/symlink handling, and add isolated controller tests showing an altered installed learner/shared file changes the dependency fingerprint or fails verification.
evidence_gaps: EG01: C05's required guest-versus-signed-in denial evidence is incomplete. docs/planning/evidence/C05/native-acceptance.json covers a guest knowledge-check refusal and successful signed-in reads/submission, but its underlying native/observations.json contains no non-2xx learner response. Add a source-bound native case where hosted content access is denied to a signed-in learner, preserving the FORBIDDEN/domain reason and distinguishing it from guest sign-in and not-found. Include relevant visible mutation-failure/unknown-outcome checks from RF01/RF02 rather than relying only on transport-level tests.

EG02: The required hermetic shared learner regression gate was not extended. docs/architecture/qualification.md:89-90 requires C05/C06 to extend vitest.presentation.config.ts with learner-export suites and both consumers' regressions; the pinned .inputs/academy/vitest.presentation.config.ts:21-37 still selects only the earlier presentation/shell/theme suites. The registered shared run reports those 207 tests. evidence/C05/academy-regression.log is a brief command/count summary for a separate 642-test run, without raw output, effective environment or a controller run binding it to frozen inputs. Extend the approved hermetic scope to the learner export/host and affected web compositions and retain actual source-bound execution evidence, including regression cases for the shared-state and failure-presentation defects.
limitations: Independently recomputed all four supplied fingerprints, the 299-entry source inventory, referenced run/log/artifact hashes and the C04 passing predecessor receipt; all matched. Matching hashes establish consistency, not independent authorship of submitted logs or native observations.

Independently executed the existing synthetic academy_learner and academy_identity test binaries: 7/7 and 22/22 passed. Inspected their scripted stores/vaults and loopback TLS harness. No application-source changes, real credentials or product endpoints were used.

The three independent presentation reproductions compiled the pinned component sources in memory and used real React DOM/JSDOM with scripted hook inputs and simplified leaf components. They establish the reported component behavior; they are not native-window or full-provider acceptance runs.

Reviewed the registered 119-test desktop run, 33 core tests, shared presentation results, truth-graph report, literal transport fixtures, and C05/C01/C04 native records. Native interaction was submitted by the implementer and was inspected through records and AX evidence, not repeated by this reviewer; spoken VoiceOver output was not recorded.

Independently recomputed the registered C05 workload statistics: learner-call overhead p95 1.984 ms (100 samples), catalog-to-lesson p95 61.335292 ms (20), and process-tree RSS maximum 330.7 MiB (20), all within the unchanged C04 budgets. AX visibility is a rendering proxy and summed WebKit RSS has the previously documented measurement limits.

D029's lab preview and prerendered diagrams are explicitly disclosed and do not themselves block C05. Hosted service qualification remains C25, signing/installed DMG qualification remains C26, and the previously recorded long typed-input accessibility memory issue remains assigned to C24.
